dataset.name: TIGQA — Tigrinya Question Answering
dataset.notes: SQuAD-format extractive QA, stored flat (title/context/qas, with no 'paragraphs' level). 797 question-answer pairs over 365 contexts, split 80/10/10 by context with seed 42: 644/67/86 questions over 292/36/37 contexts. 1,039 abstractive and 272 unanswerable items were excluded upstream, since answer_start == -1 cannot be scored by span extraction; no negative offsets remain. See docs/DATASET_PROVENANCE.md.
